snap-title: Vault Time Travel: Versioned Encrypted Snapshots
snap-desc: An end to accidental password deletions and data loss. Travel back in time to any point in your vault's history instantly with zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM and Argon2id encryption.
snap-f1-desc: Freeze your vault state with a single click or restore an earlier snapshot. A safety snapshot is automatically captured before any restore, guaranteeing you never lose work.
snap-f2-desc: Every snapshot is encrypted locally on your device with keys derived from your master password. Zero plaintext data ever touches a server or cloud.
snap-f3-desc: Set snapshots to run automatically when the vault locks, every 24 hours, or weekly. Keep working with full peace of mind while protection runs silently.
snap-f4-desc: Choose your retention limit (10, 20, 30, or 50); oldest snapshots prune automatically. Export any snapshot as an encrypted .ks file for cold storage anytime.

hero-title: Your Data Stays Safe On Your Device Only.
hero-desc: KalderaShield is a local-first, open-source credentials manager built with zero-knowledge security architecture, requiring no internet connectivity or third-party cloud infrastructure.
video-desc: An overview of the architecture, cryptographic components, and supported platforms.
sec-desc: Vault data is encrypted on-device. Protection depends on master-password strength, the KDF parameters stored with the vault, device security, and how the application is used. No cryptographic design guarantees protection in every attack scenario.
sec-c1-desc: Every record is encrypted using an isolated 256-bit AES-GCM key derived via WebCrypto HKDF-SHA256 per item.
sec-c2-desc: Argon2id raises the cost of offline password guessing. Defaults: Tauri native desktop/Android, 64 MiB / 4 iterations / 2 lanes; Web/WASM, 32 MiB / 3 iterations / 1 lane. Existing vaults keep their stored parameters.
sec-c3-desc: The master password and derived keys are processed client-side. Protection also depends on the security of the device running the application and the user's environment.
sim-desc: Explore the theoretical workload impact of the parameters. This simulator does not measure attacker hardware, password-cracking time, or provide a security guarantee.
sim-info-note: 💡 Tauri native desktop/Android: Argon2id 64 MiB / 4 passes / 2 lanes. Web/WASM: 32 MiB / 3 / 1. Illustrative calculation; not a measured attack-cost benchmark.
flow-s1-desc: Master password is entered and immediately converted to a secure Uint8Array buffer.
flow-s2-desc: Tauri native desktop/Android: 64 MiB / 4 passes / 2 lanes. Web/WASM: 32 MiB / 3 passes / 1 lane.
flow-s3-desc: KEK decrypts the isolated Database Encryption Key (DEK) via AES-256-GCM.
flow-s4-desc: Decrypted DEK interacts with SQLite inside Origin Private File System via WebCrypto.
flow-s5-desc: On vault lock or timeout, all cryptographic keys are securely zeroized from RAM.
feat-desc: An architecture designed for frictionless productivity without lowering security boundaries.
feat-c1-desc: Your credentials live in your browser or desktop app's isolated Origin Private File System directly inside a native SQLite database. 100% resilient to network outages.
feat-c2-desc: The desktop application communicates with the extension over a dynamically selected loopback TCP port. A pairing token authenticates the connection, and XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypts message frames.
feat-c3-desc: The network policy restricts unexpected outbound connections. Offline use is supported; enabled features and configuration can affect network behavior.
feat-c4-desc: Generate and autofill RFC 6238 time-based one-time codes without relying on external 2FA mobile apps.
feat-c5-desc: Unlock your vault effortlessly using Windows Hello, Touch ID, Face ID, or Android Biometrics through native platform bindings.
rec-title: Even If You Forget Your Password, Your Data Stays Safe
rec-desc: Industry-standard BIP-39 24-word recovery phrase ensures you can regain access to your vault if you forget your master password. Keys are generated solely on your device.
rec-c1-desc: 24-word phrase containing 256 bits of entropy, compatible with standard cryptographic wallets.
rec-c2-desc: Generated using cryptographically secure CSPRNG on your device. Never touches any server.
rec-c3-desc: Master key is bound to the phrase via PBKDF2-SHA256 (600k passes) and unlocked with AES-256-GCM.
rec-c4-desc: Export your printable Emergency Kit in PDF and encrypted TXT format for disaster recovery.
rec-callout-title: ⚠️ Store your recovery phrase in a secure offline location
rec-callout-desc: Your 24-word phrase is the only fallback to recover your vault. Keep it in a physical safe, engraved on metal, or on an encrypted offline drive. Never store plaintext screenshots in cloud storage.
ext-desc: Full Mozilla Public Suffix List (10k+ rules) eTLD+1 domain isolation and closed Shadow DOM autofill protection.
ext-c1-desc: One-click install via Chrome Web Store. Manifest V3 compliant with F6 security hardening.
ext-c2-desc: Officially signed via Firefox Add-ons (AMO). Passed Mozilla's stringent security review.
ext-c3-desc: Native Safari extension optimized for macOS Sonoma and above. Signed via Apple App Store.
ext-feat-2: eTLD+1 Domain Matching (33+ Public Suffix Rules)
ext-feat-4: TOTP QR Scanner & WebAuthn PRF Support

faq-desc: Answers to the most common questions about KalderaShield.
faq-a1: Yes. KalderaShield is free to use, and its source code is published in a public GitHub repository. There are no subscriptions or premium tiers.
faq-a2: Your data is stored exclusively on your device (OPFS sandbox or local file system) encrypted with AES-256-GCM. It is never transmitted to any cloud server.
faq-q3: Can I use it on multiple devices?
faq-a3: Yes. You can securely export your encrypted vault and transfer it across multiple devices using USB, local network, or any method of your choice.
faq-q4: What happens if I lose my master password?
faq-a4: KalderaShield provides an industry-standard 24-word BIP-39 recovery phrase. If kept securely, it allows you to restore access even if you forget your master password. If both are lost, zero-knowledge architecture means nobody can recover your data.
faq-a5: Source code and security documentation are public. No completed independent third-party audit report has been published yet.
faq-a6: Windows (MSI/EXE/Portable), Linux (DEB/AppImage), Android (APK), and Chrome/Firefox/Safari browser extensions are available now. macOS and iOS support is under active development.

privacy-p1-1: KalderaShield's zero-knowledge, offline-first design means the passwords, usernames, notes, passkeys and attachments stored in your vault are never collected, processed or shared. They stay on your device, encrypted with keys derived from your master password. We never hold a copy of your master password or any derived key.
privacy-p1-2: This site uses no tracking cookies, no advertising cookies, no fingerprinting and no analytics scripts. Visitor behaviour is not measured and no third-party requests are made. The only data stored is your interface language preference, kept in your browser's local storage — it never leaves your device.
privacy-p1-3: Application and extension packages are distributed via GitHub Releases. GitHub/Microsoft's own privacy practices apply to those downloads; no data is transmitted to us in the process. The install.sh script reads the release version and SHA-256 digests from GitHub Releases solely for integrity verification.
